description: iPhone compact discovery announcement: one 128-bit service UUID (PROTOCOL 'Experimental iPhone compact discovery'). Layout of U (128-bit BE integer of the canonical UUID string): 127..112 magic 0xC8D6; 111..110 version (1 = fixed prefix, 2 = rotating ID); 109..108 kind (0 call offer, 1 viewer request, 2 stream offer, 3 rejected); 107..60 node prefix; 59 GATT, 58 relay capable, 57 paused (stream offers only); 56..54 codec mask (54 VP9, 55 AV1, 56 reserved H.264); 53..50 route cost; 49..19 route token bits 30..0 (bit 31 implied); 18..0 kind-specific. announcement flags: 0x01 accepting connections, 0x02 relay capable, 0x04 stream available, 0x08 GATT transport, 0x10 Classic transport, 0x20 stream paused, 0x40 private call available, 0x80 route recovery. capabilitySummary: bit0 VP9, bit1 AV1, bit2 reserved H.264, bit3 dual-listening hint, bit4 relayed-call consent. Integers named *_hex are big-endian lowercase hex.
